correctness.rationale: For the finite free Borel complex over the DVR \(R=\mathbb F_2[[q]]\), the structure theorem gives a free part plus cyclic \(q\)-primary torsion. The localization theorem fixes free rank \(2^{c-1}\). Universal coefficients with \(R/(q^N)\) contribute \(N\) for each free summand and twice \(\min(N,a)\) for each torsion summand, once from tensor and once from Tor. First and second finite differences then recover the tail counts and exact multiplicities of every exponent. The proof makes no inference from finite experiments.
